description: This PHP class defines a form handler for converting YAML icon extractor settings into Drupal Form API elements, supporting various input types, enums, and color formatting.

classes.name: IconExtractorSettingsForm
classes.description: A class for transforming YAML icon extractor settings into Drupal Form API elements, supporting various data types and enum options.

methods.name: generateSettingsForm
methods.description: Creates a Drupal form array from icon pack settings, handling enums and scalar types.

methods.name: initSettingForm
methods.description: Initializes form element properties from JSON schema-like settings, including title, description, and default value.

methods.name: buildEnumForm
methods.description: Builds a select form element for enum settings.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Generates options list for enum settings, supporting descriptions via meta:enum.

methods.name: buildBooleanForm
methods.description: Builds a checkbox form element for boolean settings.

methods.name: buildStringForm
methods.description: Builds a textfield or color picker for string settings, supporting pattern, maxLength, minLength, and color format.

methods.name: buildNumberForm
methods.description: Builds a number input for number or integer settings, supporting min, max, and step.
